captions.detailed: This 3D model features a pair of vintage-style opera glasses. It consists of two main cylindrical barrels, each with a black grip section, bronze ends, and light-blue glass lenses. The barrels are connected by a central bronze hinge mechanism that allows them to pivot, and a small crown focus wheel is mounted on top of the bridge assembly.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a vintage opera glass. It should feature two cylindrical barrels with black main bodies and bronze trim, connected by a central pivoting bridge. Include a small bronze focus wheel assembly on the bridge, and set up a revolute joint representing the folding action of the barrels.
captions.factory: The model is built by defining individual parts for the left and right barrels, the bridge hinge, and the focus wheel. Cylinders of varying diameters and lengths are used to construct the multi-tiered barrels (with black, bronze, and glass materials applied to different segments). A central revolute joint connects the left and right assemblies, modeled with a pivot axis, while the bridge structure is built using box extrusions and cylinders to form the hinge and focus wheel.
